contentPattern.structure: meta line (date + read-time) + H1 title + author byline + back-to-blog link

suitableFor: blog / article page headers with publish date, read-time, title and byline
editorial article intro headers with a back-to-listing link
text-driven page headers without a background image
notSuitableFor: lead-capture heros with an inline form
product landing heros with a large screenshot
